Local preview of the site's Publications page.

This file lives in preview/ on purpose: its knit output must never land at the
repo root, where it would overwrite the real publications.html.
Requires: install.packages("yaml")
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(yaml)
```

```{r assets}
cat('<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">',
    '<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">',
    '<style>', paste(readLines("../assets/css/listing.css", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), '</style>',
    sep = "\n")
```

```{r page}
d <- yaml::read_yaml("../_data/publications.yml")
s <- yaml::read_yaml("../_data/scholarship.yml")

esc  <- function(x) gsub("<", "&lt;", gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE)
bold <- function(x) gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*", "<b>\\1</b>", esc(x))

year <- vapply(d, function(e) e$year, numeric(1))
d    <- d[order(-year)]
year <- sort(year, decreasing = TRUE)
first <- vapply(d, function(e) startsWith(e$authors, "**Howard, W."), logical(1))

cat('<div class="lst" data-listing>',
    '<header class="lst-head"><div class="lst-head-row"><h1>Publications</h1>',
    sprintf('<div class="lst-span">%d&ndash;%d</div></div>', min(year), max(year)),
    '<p class="lst-intro">Peer-reviewed articles in pediatrics, developmental science, and',
    'quantitative methods. Filter by period or search a title, coauthor, or journal.</p></header>',
    '<div class="lst-stats">',
    sprintf('<div class="lst-stat"><b>%d</b><span>Peer-reviewed articles</span></div>', length(d)),
    sprintf('<div class="lst-stat"><b>%s</b><span>Citations</span></div>', s$citations),
    sprintf('<div class="lst-stat"><b>%s</b><span>h-index</span></div>', s$h_index),
    sprintf('<div class="lst-stat"><b>%d</b><span>Since 2020</span></div>', sum(year >= 2020)),
    '</div>', sep = "\n")

decade <- paste0(floor(year / 10) * 10, "s")
chips <- c(sprintf('<button type="button" class="lst-chip" data-group="all" aria-pressed="true">All <i>%d</i></button>', length(d)))
for (dec in unique(decade)) {
  chips <- c(chips, sprintf('<button type="button" class="lst-chip" data-group="%s" aria-pressed="false">%s <i>%d</i></button>',
                            dec, dec, sum(decade == dec)))
}
chips <- c(chips, sprintf('<button type="button" class="lst-chip" data-group="first" aria-pressed="false">First author <i>%d</i></button>', sum(first)))
cat('<div class="lst-bar"><div class="lst-chips">', paste(chips, collapse = ""),
    '</div><input type="search" class="lst-search" placeholder="Search title, coauthor, journal"></div>',
    '<p class="lst-empty">Nothing matches that filter.</p>',
    sprintf('<section class="lst-section"><div class="lst-group"><h2>Peer-reviewed articles</h2><span>%d</span></div>', length(d)),
    sep = "\n")

for (i in seq_along(d)) {
  e <- d[[i]]
  links <- if (!is.null(e$links))
    sprintf('<div class="lst-links">%s</div>',
            paste(vapply(e$links, function(l)
              sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', l$url, esc(l$label)),
              character(1)), collapse = "")) else ""
  impact <- if (!is.null(e$impact)) {
    val <- if (!is.null(e$impact_url))
      sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', e$impact_url, e$impact) else e$impact
    sprintf(' &middot; Impact factor %s', val)
  } else ""
  cat(sprintf(paste0('<article class="lst-item" data-groups="%s%s"><div><div class="lst-year">%d</div>%s</div>',
                     '<div>%s<h3>%s</h3><p class="lst-authors">%s</p>',
                     '<p class="lst-venue"><em>%s</em>%s%s</p>%s</div></article>'),
              decade[i], if (first[i]) "|first" else "", e$year,
              if (!is.null(e$impact)) sprintf('<div class="lst-month">IF %s</div>', e$impact) else "",
              if (first[i]) '<div class="lst-tags"><span class="lst-kind is-accent">First author</span></div>' else "",
              esc(e$title), bold(e$authors), esc(e$journal),
              if (!is.null(e$details)) paste0(", ", esc(e$details)) else "", impact, links))
}
cat('</section>')

cat(sprintf('<p class="lst-note">Citation count and h-index from Google Scholar, last checked %s.</p>', s$updated))
cat('</div>')

cat('<script>', paste(readLines("../assets/js/listing.js", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), '</script>', sep = "\n")
```
